title: Inti Creates' Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced Game Collection Launches for Switch 2 on October 22
content: Inti Creates revealed in a new trailer on Wednesday for Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced — a collection of polished and updated versions of its Azure Striker Gunvolt , Azure Striker Gunvolt 2 , and Azure Striker Gunvolt 3 games — that it will launch for Nintendo Switch 2 on October 22.
author: ANN

title: Singer Taiiku Okazaki Announces Hiatus to Focus on Health
content: Singer Taiiku Okazaki announced on his official website on Wednesday that he is suspending activities due to ongoing physical and mental health issues, and based on a doctor's diagnosis. All scheduled events and performances scheduled for the year are cancelled.
author: ANN

title: Muv-Luv Tactics Game Reveals Trailer, 2027 Release
content: The staff for the Muv-Luv franchise announced on Wednesday that the Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare (also listed as Muv-Luv: Tactics - The Nightmare of Kalidasa ) strategy role-playing game will launch for PC via Steam in 2027.
author: ANN

title: The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles x Naruto Crossover Returns in 2026 With New Manga Edition
content: In 2024, one of the wildest crossovers to ever take place between the worlds of Japanese manga and North American comic books began. The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles found themselves dropped into a brand new world where they encountered the ninjas of the Naruto franchise.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix’s One Piece Reboot Anime Didn’t Recast Luffy & That’s a Big Mistake
content: One Piece has a new anime reboot now in the works with Netflix, and it has made a big mistake with the confirmation that it will feature the same Monkey D. Luffy voice actor from the original TV series.
author: ComicBook

content: Warning! Massive spoilers for Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 to follow! Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 has dropped its first major trailer, and with it has already spoiled a major Sukuna twist that gives away how it could all come to an end.

title: Fifth Season of 'Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e' Announced
content: The 16th and final episode of the Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e 4th Season ( Classroom of the Elite 4th Season ) anime series announced a fifth season on Wednesday, revealing a celebratory visual (pictured).

title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Anime's 2nd Promo Video Reveals Theme Songs
content: The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of Hekiru Hikawa 's Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life ( Hanaori-san wa Tensei Shite mo Kenka ga Shitai ) manga began streaming on Wednesday the second promotional video.

title: Singapore Studio Kasagi Labo Reveals Ars Gratia Project
content: American animation news outlet Cartoon Brew reported that Singapore-based anime venture studio Kasagi Labo announced during its panel at this year's Annecy International Animation Film Festival on Wednesday the new tentatively titled original sci-fi feature Ars Gratia .
author: ANN
